verdict.rationale: ByteAsk ships an official CLI with documented subcommands (`exec`, `queue`), flags (`--ask-for-approval`, `--sandbox workspace-write`), and a dedicated CLI reference page, plus a headless/scripting mode for CI pipelines and JSON Lines output — clearly serving AI-native/agentic workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and the cli-reference page content itself wasn't quoted in detail.
